src: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.
tgt: हामी धेरै ग्रिक राजनीतिज्ञहरू, वैज्ञानिकहरू र कलाकारहरूलाई चिन्छौँ। सम्भवतः यस संस्कृतिको सबैभन्दा प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति होमर, पौराणिक अन्धो कवि हुन्, जसले ग्रिक साहित्यका दुई उत्कृष्ट कृतिहरू रचना गरेका थिएः इलियड र ओडिसी।

src: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.
tgt: <औपचारिक> अनुमतिहरू घाटीको सुरक्षाका लागि सीमित छन्, र महिनाको पहिलो दिन, सुरु हुने महिनाभन्दा चार महिना अघि उपलब्ध हुन्छन्।

src: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

src: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.
